faqs.a:
(a)
Overflow prohibited.
A user shall ensure that any use of a canal or ditch does not result in any waste
               or overflow water encroaching upon or overtaking any street, or alley in the city
               so as to damage the same in any way. It shall be unlawful for any user to permit any
               waste or overflow water or any water from any canal, ditch, tail ditch, waste ditch,
               or any part thereof to flow in or upon any street, or alley in the city so as to damage
               the same in any way.
(b)
Repair and maintenance.
A user shall ensure that all embankments of any canal or ditch related to, or affected
               by their use are maintained in good repair and condition so that the waters within
               are not wasted and will not flood or damage the premises of others.
(c)
Tail ditch required during repair or maintenance required.
During any repair or maintenance activities, the user must make a tail ditch so as
               to return the water within the canal or ditch with as little waste as possible into
               the stream from which it was taken. Failure to do so shall be unlawful.
(
Ord. No. 4875
, § 1, 8-19-2024)
